sources.note: Main company site. Describes three product lines: communication services, Cardiac Signals, and Healthcare IT/escribeHOST. Mentions 25+ years, 4M+ interactions, HIPAA-compliant. escribeHOST described only briefly as 'customizable tools for surveys, reminders, tracking'.

ONC transparency page for escribeHOST v7. Lists certified criteria, mentions DynaMed as additional software, confirms clinical documentation, CPOE, e-prescribing, CQMs, FHIR APIs, security features. Real-world testing results 2022-2025.

escribeHOST product page. Describes automated appointment reminders (SMS/email/phone), advanced scheduling with templates, patient portal with results/notes/education/messaging, task management, medication management with e-prescribing, integration with billing/lab/hospital systems. Cloud-based, cross-platform.

Release notes for versions 7.2–7.85. Revealed extensive cardiac device management features, bariatric notes, document signing workflows, eRx via Surescripts, scheduling enhancements, task management system, ICD-10/CPT/SNOMED-CT/LOINC support, FHIR APIs.

Alternative main page (escribe.com). Similar content to lillegroup.com. Describes Cardiac Signals as vendor-neutral platform supporting Medtronic, Abbott, Boston Scientific, Biotronik. Mentions IEEE standards participation.

Capital Cardiology Associates describes using eScribe for e-prescribing, patient portal with medications/lab results/medical history, hospital connectivity for health information exchange. Achieved Meaningful Use through eScribe.

Patient portal FAQ showing escribeHOST portal features: messaging providers, document upload (PDF), viewing medical documents, appointment info, test results. Portal hosted at portal.escribe.com/ehr/. Emails from noreply@lillegroup.com.

2020 press release on Cardiac Signals launch. Albany, NY-based company. Platform manages 'tens of thousands' of cardiac device patients. Can integrate into any EHR or stand-alone. Capital Cardiology Associates cited as customer. No mention of escribeHOST relationship.

Cardiac Signals product page. Details: automatic 24/7/365 transmission download from manufacturers, HIPAA/FIPS compliant, advanced filtering, manufacturer alerts, documentation tracking, text/email notifications, analytics dashboard, billing automation identifying all billing opportunities daily.
SSL certificate error prevented access. Dedicated escribeHOST marketing site exists but could not be loaded.
